gdpr.title: Email ICUE's data contact
gdpr.body: Tell us which right you want to exercise, the data or period it concerns, and enough detail for ICUE to verify who you are. Please do not send images of identity documents unless we have asked for them over a secure channel.

cookies.intro: This tool stores your choice in the browser you are using now. ICUE's optional integrations can read it through the <0>{{event}}</0> event.

essential.title: Essential cookies
essential.description: Required for security and core functionality.

performance.title: Performance cookies
performance.description: Help us measure and improve the website.

functional.title: Functional cookies
functional.description: Remember your language and interface choices.

status.saved: Your choices are saved on this device.
status.blocked: Your browser is blocking local storage, so the choices could not be saved.
